progress.title: Progress

JobEnvelope.title: JobEnvelope

JobResult.description:
Final outcome of one job attempt, stored in ``jobs.result_json`` (or ``error_json`` when failed).

``BLOCKED`` (internal) means the job could not run on its target at all (e.g. ``TARGET_BLOCKED``: the target
device is unavailable); it is never retried and never produces a proxy measurement.
JobResult.title: JobResult

seq_start.description: sequence number of messages[0]; the rest follow densely
seq_start.title: Seq Start

ProgressMessage.description: One JSONL line from a worker child (``type=result`` carries the JobResult in ``payload``).
ProgressMessage.title: ProgressMessage

PruneAck.description: E11 answer: the checkpoint row is PRUNED (``replayed``: the request was already reported; nothing changed).
PruneAck.title: PruneAck

PruneOrder.description:
One retention prune request of the core (DD-A66; WP-5 section 2 R11) for a checkpoint this runner registered.

The runner deletes ``<work_root>/runs/<run_id>/<relpath>`` - and, for a ``full_eNNNN.pt`` payload, the RF-DETR
``native_eNNNN.ckpt`` beside it; the ``.sha256.json`` sidecar is kept - only when it is a regular file (no symlink)
inside its own work root whose bytes hash to ``sha256``, then reports with E11. Nothing is deleted for an order it
cannot verify. ``request_id`` is the idempotency key of the round trip.

policy.description: retention policy of the run (keep_all never produces an order)
policy.title: Policy

relpath.description: run_dir-relative location of the full-state payload on this runner
relpath.title: Relpath

PruneOrder.title: PruneOrder

PruneReport.description:
E11 body: the outcome of one :class:`PruneOrder`, sent only after the unlink succeeded (``removed`` lists what was
deleted, ``bytes_freed`` their size) or when no file with the ordered digest is at ``relpath`` any more
(``already_absent``: e.g. the stage trainer pruned it, or other bytes now live under that name - nothing deleted).
Not job-scoped (no ticket): the order may be reported after its lease ended; only the runner that holds the copy
may report it (token binding + the request's runner).
PruneReport.title: PruneReport

PrunedItem.description: A file the runner unlinked for a prune order (run-relative; ``sha256`` known for the payload only).
PrunedItem.title: PrunedItem
